"""Download subtitle-only files for the Desktop input and record an audit."""

import csv
import contextlib
import io
import json
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import yt_dlp

from srt_to_txt import convert, parse_srt

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUTPUT = Path('C:/Users/djliz/Desktop/YouTube_자막_2026-10-12')


class QuietLogger:
    """Keep subtitle language tables and signed URLs out of progress output."""

    def debug(self, message: str) -> None:
        pass

    def warning(self, message: str) -> None:
        pass

    def error(self, message: str) -> None:
        pass


def save_report(rows: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Save resumable results and an Excel-compatible inventory."""
    (OUTPUT / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    keys = ['index', 'title', 'url', 'status', 'language', 'duration', 'last_caption', 'lines', 'txt', 'error']
    with (OUTPUT / '영상목록.csv').open('w', encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=keys, extrasaction='ignore')
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


def main() -> None:
    """Enumerate the playlist, download captions, and verify each text file."""
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
    OUTPUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    source = Path('C:/Users/djliz/Desktop/txt.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    base = dict(skip_download=True, quiet=True, logger=QuietLogger(), noplaylist=True,
                socket_timeout=25, retries=2, extractor_retries=2)
    with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL({**base, 'extract_flat': True}) as ydl:
        playlist = ydl.extract_info('https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUJ2dfg-s59lnjaPfctqyfE1l8inGFqFK', download=False)
    ids = list(dict.fromkeys([e['id'] for e in playlist['entries']] +
                            re.findall(r'"videoId"\s*:\s*"([\w-]{11})"', source) +
                            re.findall(r'(?:watch\?v=|youtu\.be/)([\w-]{11})', source)))
    rows = [{'index': i, 'id': vid, 'title': '', 'url': f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}',
             'status': 'pending'} for i, vid in enumerate(ids, 1)]
    previous = OUTPUT / 'results.json'
    if previous.exists():
        saved = {r['id']: r for r in json.loads(previous.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
        rows = [saved.get(r['id'], r) for r in rows]
    save_report(rows)
    for row in rows:
        if row['status'] == 'ok' and (OUTPUT / row['txt']).exists():
            continue
        print(f"START {row['index']}/{len(rows)} {row['id']}", flush=True)
        for authenticated in (False, True):
            opts = {**base, 'writesubtitles': True, 'writeautomaticsub': True,
                    'subtitleslangs': ['ko-orig', 'ko', 'en'], 'subtitlesformat': 'vtt/srt/best',
                    'outtmpl': str(OUTPUT / f"{row['index']:02d}_%(title).140s [%(id)s].%(ext)s"),
                    'postprocessors': [{'key': 'FFmpegSubtitlesConvertor', 'format': 'srt', 'when': 'before_dl'}]}
            if authenticated:
                opts.update(cookiefile=str(ROOT / 'cookies.txt'),
                            extractor_args={'youtube': {'player_client': ['web_creator', 'web_embedded']}},
                            remote_components=['ejs:github'])
            try:
                with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(opts) as ydl:
                    info = ydl.extract_info(row['url'], download=False)
                    row.update(title=info['title'], duration=info.get('duration'))
                    manual = info.get('subtitles') or {}
                    auto = info.get('automatic_captions') or {}
                    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                        ydl.list_subtitles(row['id'], manual)
                        ydl.list_subtitles(row['id'], auto)
                    language = next((lang for lang in ('ko', 'ko-KR') if lang in manual), None)
                    language = language or next((lang for lang in ('ko-orig', 'ko', 'en-orig', 'en') if lang in auto or lang in manual), None)
                    if not language:
                        language = next((lang for lang in auto if lang.endswith('-orig')), None)
                    if not language:
                        raise ValueError('No available subtitles')
                    ydl.params['subtitleslangs'] = [language]
                    info['requested_subtitles'] = ydl.process_subtitles(row['id'], manual, auto)
                    ydl.process_info(info)
                files = [p for p in OUTPUT.glob('*.srt') if f"[{row['id']}]" in p.name]
                if not files:
                    raise ValueError('SRT file was not created')
                srt = files[0]
                txt = convert(srt)
                lines = txt.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
                if not lines or not any(lines):
                    raise ValueError('Empty subtitle text')
                if any(a == b for a, b in zip(lines, lines[1:])):
                    raise ValueError('Consecutive duplicate lines')
                content = srt.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
                ends = re.findall(r'--> (\d+):(\d+):(\d+),(\d+)', content)
                h, m, s, ms = map(int, ends[-1])
                last = h * 3600 + m * 60 + s + ms / 1000
                row.update(status='ok', language=language, last_caption=last, lines=len(lines),
                           cues=len(parse_srt(content)), txt=txt.name, srt=srt.name, error='')
                print(f"OK {row['index']}/{len(rows)} {language} lines={len(lines)} end={last}/{row['duration']}", flush=True)
                break
            except Exception as exc:
                error = re.sub(r'https?://\S+', '[URL]', str(exc))
                row.update(status='failed', error=error)
                print(f"RETRY/FAIL {row['id']} auth={authenticated}: {error[:240]}", flush=True)
        save_report(rows)
        time.sleep(1)
    print(f"DONE {sum(r['status'] == 'ok' for r in rows)}/{len(rows)} {OUTPUT}", flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Download subtitle-only files for the Desktop input and record an audit."""

import csv
import contextlib
import io
import json
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import yt_dlp

from srt_to_txt import convert, parse_srt

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUTPUT = Path('C:/Users/djliz/Desktop/YouTube_자막_2026-10-12')


class QuietLogger:
    """Keep subtitle language tables and signed URLs out of progress output."""

    def debug(self, message: str) -> None:
        pass

    def warning(self, message: str) -> None:
        pass

    def error(self, message: str) -> None:
        pass


def save_report(rows: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Save resumable results and an Excel-compatible inventory."""
    (OUTPUT / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    keys = ['index', 'title', 'url', 'status', 'language', 'duration', 'last_caption', 'lines', 'txt', 'error']
    with (OUTPUT / '영상목록.csv').open('w', encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=keys, extrasaction='ignore')
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


def main() -> None:
    """Enumerate the playlist, download captions, and verify each text file."""
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
    OUTPUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    source = Path('C:/Users/djliz/Desktop/txt.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    base = dict(skip_download=True, quiet=True, logger=QuietLogger(), noplaylist=True,
                socket_timeout=25, retries=2, extractor_retries=2)
    with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL({**base, 'extract_flat': True}) as ydl:
        playlist = ydl.extract_info('https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUJ2dfg-s59lnjaPfctqyfE1l8inGFqFK', download=False)
    ids = list(dict.fromkeys([e['id'] for e in playlist['entries']] +
                            re.findall(r'"videoId"\s*:\s*"([\w-]{11})"', source) +
                            re.findall(r'(?:watch\?v=|youtu\.be/)([\w-]{11})', source)))
    rows = [{'index': i, 'id': vid, 'title': '', 'url': f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}',
             'status': 'pending'} for i, vid in enumerate(ids, 1)]
    previous = OUTPUT / 'results.json'
    if previous.exists():
        saved = {r['id']: r for r in json.loads(previous.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
        rows = [saved.get(r['id'], r) for r in rows]
    save_report(rows)
    for row in rows:
        if row['status'] == 'ok' and (OUTPUT / row['txt']).exists():
            continue
        print(f"START {row['index']}/{len(rows)} {row['id']}", flush=True)
        for authenticated in (False, True):
            opts = {**base, 'writesubtitles': True, 'writeautomaticsub': True,
                    'subtitleslangs': ['ko-orig', 'ko', 'en'], 'subtitlesformat': 'vtt/srt/best',
                    'outtmpl': str(OUTPUT / f"{row['index']:02d}_%(title).140s [%(id)s].%(ext)s"),
                    'postprocessors': [{'key': 'FFmpegSubtitlesConvertor', 'format': 'srt', 'when': 'before_dl'}]}
            if authenticated:
                opts.update(cookiefile=str(ROOT / 'cookies.txt'),
                            extractor_args={'youtube': {'player_client': ['web_creator', 'web_embedded']}},
                            remote_components=['ejs:github'])
            try:
                with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(opts) as ydl:
                    info = ydl.extract_info(row['url'], download=False)
                    row.update(title=info['title'], duration=info.get('duration'))
                    manual = info.get('subtitles') or {}
                    auto = info.get('automatic_captions') or {}
                    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                        ydl.list_subtitles(row['id'], manual)
                        ydl.list_subtitles(row['id'], auto)
                    language = next((lang for lang in ('ko', 'ko-KR') if lang in manual), None)
                    language = language or next((lang for lang in ('ko-orig', 'ko', 'en-orig', 'en') if lang in auto or lang in manual), None)
                    if not language:
                        language = next((lang for lang in auto if lang.endswith('-orig')), None)
                    if not language:
                        raise ValueError('No available subtitles')
                    ydl.params['subtitleslangs'] = [language]
                    info['requested_subtitles'] = ydl.process_subtitles(row['id'], manual, auto)
                    ydl.process_info(info)
                files = [p for p in OUTPUT.glob('*.srt') if f"[{row['id']}]" in p.name]
                if not files:
                    raise ValueError('SRT file was not created')
                srt = files[0]
                txt = convert(srt)
                lines = txt.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
                if not lines or not any(lines):
                    raise ValueError('Empty subtitle text')
                if any(a == b for a, b in zip(lines, lines[1:])):
                    raise ValueError('Consecutive duplicate lines')
                content = srt.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
                ends = re.findall(r'--> (\d+):(\d+):(\d+),(\d+)', content)
                h, m, s, ms = map(int, ends[-1])
                last = h * 3600 + m * 60 + s + ms / 1000
                row.update(status='ok', language=language, last_caption=last, lines=len(lines),
                           cues=len(parse_srt(content)), txt=txt.name, srt=srt.name, error='')
                print(f"OK {row['index']}/{len(rows)} {language} lines={len(lines)} end={last}/{row['duration']}", flush=True)
                break
            except Exception as exc:
                error = re.sub(r'https?://\S+', '[URL]', str(exc))
                row.update(status='failed', error=error)
                print(f"RETRY/FAIL {row['id']} auth={authenticated}: {error[:240]}", flush=True)
        save_report(rows)
        time.sleep(1)
    print(f"DONE {sum(r['status'] == 'ok' for r in rows)}/{len(rows)} {OUTPUT}", flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

"""Download subtitle-only files for the Desktop input and record an audit."""

import csv
import contextlib
import io
import json
import re
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

import yt_dlp

from srt_to_txt import convert, parse_srt

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUTPUT = Path('C:/Users/djliz/Desktop/YouTube_자막_2026-10-12')


class QuietLogger:
    """Keep subtitle language tables and signed URLs out of progress output."""

    def debug(self, message: str) -> None:
        pass

    def warning(self, message: str) -> None:
        pass

    def error(self, message: str) -> None:
        pass


def save_report(rows: list[dict]) -> None:
    """Save resumable results and an Excel-compatible inventory."""
    (OUTPUT / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
    keys = ['index', 'title', 'url', 'status', 'language', 'duration', 'last_caption', 'lines', 'txt', 'error']
    with (OUTPUT / '영상목록.csv').open('w', encoding='utf-8-sig', newline='') as stream:
        writer = csv.DictWriter(stream, fieldnames=keys, extrasaction='ignore')
        writer.writeheader()
        writer.writerows(rows)


def main() -> None:
    """Enumerate the playlist, download captions, and verify each text file."""
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding='utf-8')
    OUTPUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    source = Path('C:/Users/djliz/Desktop/txt.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    base = dict(skip_download=True, quiet=True, logger=QuietLogger(), noplaylist=True,
                socket_timeout=25, retries=2, extractor_retries=2)
    with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL({**base, 'extract_flat': True}) as ydl:
        playlist = ydl.extract_info('https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLUJ2dfg-s59lnjaPfctqyfE1l8inGFqFK', download=False)
    ids = list(dict.fromkeys([e['id'] for e in playlist['entries']] +
                            re.findall(r'"videoId"\s*:\s*"([\w-]{11})"', source) +
                            re.findall(r'(?:watch\?v=|youtu\.be/)([\w-]{11})', source)))
    rows = [{'index': i, 'id': vid, 'title': '', 'url': f'https://www.youtube.com/watch?v={vid}',
             'status': 'pending'} for i, vid in enumerate(ids, 1)]
    previous = OUTPUT / 'results.json'
    if previous.exists():
        saved = {r['id']: r for r in json.loads(previous.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))}
        rows = [saved.get(r['id'], r) for r in rows]
    save_report(rows)
    for row in rows:
        if row['status'] == 'ok' and (OUTPUT / row['txt']).exists():
            continue
        print(f"START {row['index']}/{len(rows)} {row['id']}", flush=True)
        for authenticated in (False, True):
            opts = {**base, 'writesubtitles': True, 'writeautomaticsub': True,
                    'subtitleslangs': ['ko-orig', 'ko', 'en'], 'subtitlesformat': 'vtt/srt/best',
                    'outtmpl': str(OUTPUT / f"{row['index']:02d}_%(title).140s [%(id)s].%(ext)s"),
                    'postprocessors': [{'key': 'FFmpegSubtitlesConvertor', 'format': 'srt', 'when': 'before_dl'}]}
            if authenticated:
                opts.update(cookiefile=str(ROOT / 'cookies.txt'),
                            extractor_args={'youtube': {'player_client': ['web_creator', 'web_embedded']}},
                            remote_components=['ejs:github'])
            try:
                with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(opts) as ydl:
                    info = ydl.extract_info(row['url'], download=False)
                    row.update(title=info['title'], duration=info.get('duration'))
                    manual = info.get('subtitles') or {}
                    auto = info.get('automatic_captions') or {}
                    with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
                        ydl.list_subtitles(row['id'], manual)
                        ydl.list_subtitles(row['id'], auto)
                    language = next((lang for lang in ('ko', 'ko-KR') if lang in manual), None)
                    language = language or next((lang for lang in ('ko-orig', 'ko', 'en-orig', 'en') if lang in auto or lang in manual), None)
                    if not language:
                        language = next((lang for lang in auto if lang.endswith('-orig')), None)
                    if not language:
                        raise ValueError('No available subtitles')
                    ydl.params['subtitleslangs'] = [language]
                    info['requested_subtitles'] = ydl.process_subtitles(row['id'], manual, auto)
                    ydl.process_info(info)
                files = [p for p in OUTPUT.glob('*.srt') if f"[{row['id']}]" in p.name]
                if not files:
                    raise ValueError('SRT file was not created')
                srt = files[0]
                txt = convert(srt)
                lines = txt.read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
                if not lines or not any(lines):
                    raise ValueError('Empty subtitle text')
                if any(a == b for a, b in zip(lines, lines[1:])):
                    raise ValueError('Consecutive duplicate lines')
                content = srt.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
                ends = re.findall(r'--> (\d+):(\d+):(\d+),(\d+)', content)
                h, m, s, ms = map(int, ends[-1])
                last = h * 3600 + m * 60 + s + ms / 1000
                row.update(status='ok', language=language, last_caption=last, lines=len(lines),
                           cues=len(parse_srt(content)), txt=txt.name, srt=srt.name, error='')
                print(f"OK {row['index']}/{len(rows)} {language} lines={len(lines)} end={last}/{row['duration']}", flush=True)
                break
            except Exception as exc:
                error = re.sub(r'https?://\S+', '[URL]', str(exc))
                row.update(status='failed', error=error)
                print(f"RETRY/FAIL {row['id']} auth={authenticated}: {error[:240]}", flush=True)
        save_report(rows)
        time.sleep(1)
    print(f"DONE {sum(r['status'] == 'ok' for r in rows)}/{len(rows)} {OUTPUT}", flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
